articles.title: Tailscale Traces Database Corruption to 16y/o SQLite WAL-Reset Bug
articles.author: ropbear

zh.thesis: Tailscale追查出SQLite潜伏16年的WAL-Reset数据竞争缺陷
points: 半年19次数据库损坏，手动激进checkpoint是诱因
SQLite 3.52含修复但有表达式索引假阳性，被撤回改发3.51.3
部署tmstmpvfs shim定位竞争，2026年证实条件真实发生

en.thesis: Tailscale traced repeated database corruption to a 16-year-old SQLite WAL-Reset race condition.
points: 19 corruption events over six months, provoked by aggressive manual checkpointing.
SQLite 3.52 carries a fix but had an expression-index false positive, withdrawn for 3.51.3.
Deployed a tmstmpvfs shim to localize the race; 2026 confirmed the condition really fires.

articles.title: What sort of maths are LLMs good at?
articles.author: ColinWright

zh.thesis: LLM擅长构造反例而非概念性证明，源于海量试错
points: 非sofic群、Jacobian猜想等均为反例类成果
Skolem化使全称与存在命题可互换，逻辑形式难定类
LLM风格倾向试错碰运气，人类胜在概念性深度论证

en.thesis: LLMs excel at counterexamples rather than conceptual proofs, a product of mass trial and error.
points: Non-sofic groups, the Jacobian conjecture, and similar results are counterexample-class achievements.
Skolemization swaps universal and existential propositions, so logical form is hard to pigeonhole.
LLMs lean on luck-driven trial and error where humans win on deep conceptual argument.
LLM style favors heuristic luck-chasing; humans excel at deep conceptual argumentation.

articles.title: License plate reader searches should require a warrant
articles.author: apwheele

zh.thesis: 历史ALPR数据检索应需法院搜查令，为何是当非若
points: 保留数据不能防滥用，删除反害合法侦查与辩护
引用Carpenter、Chatrie判例，推断未来ALPR必需令状
建议第三方机构审计，设备低于3000美元成本

en.thesis: Searching historical ALPR data should require a warrant, and deleting it instead invites abuse.
points: Retaining data doesn't prevent misuse; deleting it undercuts legitimate investigations and defense.
Carpenter and Chatrie point to warrants becoming mandatory for ALPR searches.
Recommends third-party audits; readers cost under $3,000.

articles.title: AI is removing the middle class of software engineering?
articles.author: florianherrengt

zh.thesis: AI让低质量工程师产出激增，拉大软件工程师薪资差距
points: 一人下午生成2万行代码，但审查理解仍需人类
链式错误复合：5步各95%成功率，整体约77%
实现成本趋零，判断力成为六位数薪资的凭据

en.thesis: AI amplifies output of low-quality engineers and widens the salary gap among software developers.
points: One person generated 20k lines in an afternoon, yet review and understanding still need humans.
Chain errors compound: five steps at 95% success each lands at roughly 77% overall.
With implementation cost near zero, judgment becomes the credential for six-figure pay.

zh.thesis: AI agent由十种可复用架构模式组合而成，非单一调用
points: 驱动循环用前沿模型，分类抽取路由用最便宜模型
链式5步各95%成功率整体约77%，错误沿链复合
拆分各层的钱、接缝、可见性与优化胜过单一大模型

en.thesis: AI agents arise from composing ten reusable architecture patterns, not a single call.
points: The driving loop uses frontier models, while classification, extraction, and routing lean on the cheapest.
Five chained steps at 95% success each land near 77% overall as errors compound.
Splitting money, seams, observability, and optimization per layer beats one monolithic model.

articles.title: Grok 4.6 scores 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
articles.author: wertyk

zh.thesis: Grok 4.6在AA智能指数得61分，追平GPT-5.6 Sol
points: GDPval-AA Elo 1753，仅次Claude Opus 5，与Fable 5重叠置信区间
定价$2/$6每百万token，比Claude Opus 5便宜60%以上
AA-Briefcase每任务约53轮0.5B输入token，远低于Opus 5的103轮

en.thesis: Grok 4.6 scored 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, matching GPT-5.6 Sol.
points: GDPval-AA Elo of 1753 trails only Claude Opus 5, with confidence intervals overlapping Fable 5.
Priced at $2/$6 per million tokens, over 60% cheaper than Claude Opus 5.
AA-Briefcase averages about 53 rounds and 0.5B input tokens per task, far below Opus 5's 103 rounds.

zh.thesis: Grok 4.6专注长时agent与视觉交互，定价不变
points: AA智能指数61追平GPT-5.6 Sol，Fable 5 Max为62
DeepSWE 1.1达65.9%超GPT-5.6，但Terminal-Bench v3.0仅26%落后
$2/$6每百万token不变，快变体价格翻倍

en.thesis: Grok 4.6 targets long-horizon agents and visual interaction while holding its price steady.
points: AA Intelligence Index of 61 ties GPT-5.6 Sol; Fable 5 Max sits at 62.
DeepSWE 1.1 hits 65.9% trailing GPT-5.6, but Terminal-Bench v3.0 lags at 26%.
The $2/$6 per-million-token pricing is unchanged; the fast variant doubles in price.

zh.thesis: Qwen开源首个Max级模型，2.4T参数95B激活的MoE
points: 总参数2.4T，激活95B，512专家激活10个路由加1共享
上下文262144原生，可扩展至101万token
SWE-bench Pro 67.7%超GPT-5.6 Sol，DeepSWE 1.1仅56.6%

en.thesis: Qwen open-sourced its first Max-class model: a 2.4T-parameter MoE with 95B active.
points: Total 2.4T params, 95B active, routing across 512 experts with 10 routed plus 1 shared.
Native 262,144-token context, expandable to 1M tokens.
SWE-bench Pro at 67.7% beats GPT-5.6 Sol, but DeepSWE 1.1 reaches only 56.6%.

articles.title: Show HN: Woxi - Open-source Mathematica / Wolfram Language reimplementation
articles.author: adius

zh.thesis: Woxi开源复刻Mathematica，以Jupyter内核形态交付
points: woxi install-kernel可本地安装为Jupyter内核
捆绑JupyterLite浏览器版，免安装即可运行

en.thesis: Woxi is an open-source Mathematica reimplementation that ships as a Jupyter kernel.
points: woxi install-kernel sets it up locally as a Jupyter kernel.
A bundled browser-based JupyterLite lets you run it with no install.

articles.title: Google's AI found a Chrome bug hiding for 13 years, and it's only getting faster
articles.author: Rich Edmonds

zh.thesis: Google用AI代理捕获潜伏13年的Chrome漏洞并加速补丁流程
points: Chrome 149和150共修复1072个安全漏洞，超过此前23个里程碑总和
AI集成DeepMind与Project Zero工具，5月单月阻止超20个漏洞上线
计划两周大版本+每周安全补丁，试验免重启动态补丁

en.thesis: Google's AI agent caught a 13-year-old Chrome bug and is reshaping how quickly vulnerabilities get patched.
points: Chrome 149 and 150 fixed 1,072 security bugs, more than the prior 23 milestones combined.
AI hooked into DeepMind and Project Zero tools blocked over 20 vulnerabilities from shipping in May alone.
Moving to a two-week major cadence plus weekly security patches, testing restart-free dynamic patching.
